product_policies: Explicit gesture Resume, no resume-cursor overlay, pause cooldown or pause-menu music.
Clean paused runs resume; rejected input, dispatch failure and interrupted starts require Retry/Back.
Results immediately show authoritative terminal data; success drains emitted sound intent, failure/navigation/visibility loss cancels it.
limitations: No complete A19/A21/A23/A24 or W08-W10 closure.
Exact pinned pause/focus/retry visual tests not ported or executed; adapter backfill remains open.
Player failure adapter uses semantic boundary scheduling, excludes failed-at-judgement animation results from the comparison and does not establish equal automatic judgement times.
Physical inputs, audible output, release Safari, Firefox/WebKit and full performance/resource certification remain open.
Mods, other rulesets, accounts/score submission/import, menu styling and framework-native device recreation are outside this browser profile.
Controller tests use production WASM with fake audio/render resources; Chromium lifecycle tests use real Web Audio/WebGL2. Browser hot-path allocation freedom is not claimed.
